channel.title: TCH Works clothing and mugs
channel.description: Original printed T-shirts, hoodies, sweatshirts and mugs, free UK delivery

item.title: Sprouts Not Today T-shirt, Black, XS - Unisex
item.description: An original bold design for anyone who will pass the sprouts along this Christmas, thank you very much. Garment Bella+Canvas 3001 unisex tee, 142 g/m² (4.2 oz) Airlume combed ring-spun cotton (Heather grey is a cotton/polyester blend), side-seamed, retail fit Print Direct-to-garment (DTG) water-based inks on the front. Light colours are printed with a dark-ink version of the design so it stays readable. Sizes XS to 3XL, see the size guide Care Machine wash cold (30°C) inside out, no bleach, tumble dry low or hang dry, do not iron over the print Free UK delivery.
